title: Subsets with Exact Sum K

monster.name: Exact Sum Golem
monster.title: Weigher of Exact Subset Balance
monster.defeatQuote: Every subset matching target sum k identified!

description: Given an array of integers `nums` and an integer `k`, return all subsets of `nums` that sum to exactly `k`, sorted by length and then elements.
starterCode:
def subsetsSumK(nums: list[int], k: int) -> list[list[int]]:
    pass
solutionCode:
def subsetsSumK(nums: list[int], k: int) -> list[list[int]]:
    nums.sort()
    res = []
    def backtrack(idx, rem, path):
        if rem == 0:
            res.append(list(path))
            return
        for i in range(idx, len(nums)):
            if nums[i] > rem: break
            path.append(nums[i])
            backtrack(i + 1, rem - nums[i], path)
            path.pop()
    backtrack(0, k, [])
    res.sort(key=lambda s: (len(s), s))
    return res
hints: Sort nums to break early when nums[i] > rem.
